Owner, 2026-09-27: never re-skin a device colour; every device must look factory original (camera module and plateau, lens count and layout, buttons incl. Action button and Camera Control, Dynamic Island vs notch, rail material and colour — e.g. Pacific Blue's shiny chrome-blue rail). authentic:false entries are re-skins or mislabels and are refused by scripts/audit_card.mjs. faces: which way the device leans or looks ('left' suits a product on the right of a layout, 'front' suits either side).
